name: urlhaus
label: URLhaus
description: URLhaus is a project operated by abuse.ch. The purpose of the project is to collect, track and share malware URLs, helping network administrators and security analysts to protect their network and customers from cyber threats.

operations.title: Query Signature Information
operations.description:
URLhaus identifies the malware family of payloads distributed via malicious URLs. 
Signatures, unlike tags, are automatically assigned and cannot be modified by reporters. 
Use this function to fetch information about a signature.
